related_issues.reason: Also about exclude-newer-package entries and lock behaviour, but requests pruning of stale entries, not the invalidation message.
exclude-newer-package interaction with lockfile invalidation; different symptom.

rationale: Reproducible with exact commands and uv version: when multiple --exclude-newer-package entries change, the 'Resolving despite existing lockfile' message reports only the first change. The lockfile is correct, so only the diagnostic output is incomplete; this is a small uv-side bug (could be seen as an enhancement to the message). Searches found no duplicate of this specific message issue, only loosely related exclude-newer-package issues.
